source_note: Real tenancy agreement analysed by the RentCheck pipeline
summary: 4 of 7 checked clause(s) flagged, 4 expected protection(s) missing (10 clauses found in total).

flagged.label: Taxes & outgoings
flagged.evidence: all taxes, rates, duties, assessments, i mpositions and outgoings whatsoever

flagged.label: Entry without notice
flagged.evidence: at all reasonable times during the term hereby granted

flagged.label: Subletting
flagged.evidence: such consent not to be unreasonably withheld

missing.label: Clear exit / termination terms
missing.why: No notice period is stated, so either side could end the tenancy without a clear process.

missing.label: Caution fee / deposit terms
missing.why: The agreement does not say what deposit is required or whether it is refundable.

missing.label: Utilities / service charges
missing.why: The agreement does not say who pays for electricity, water, waste, or any shared service charge.

missing.label: Rent review / increase terms
missing.why: The agreement does not state how or when rent can be increased, leaving the tenant exposed to arbitrary review.

questions: Ask which taxes and rates are yours versus the landlord's, and remove open-ended 'all outgoings' language.
Ask for a clause requiring the landlord to give you advance written notice before entering the premises.
Ask for subletting or assignment to be allowed with the landlord's written consent, which cannot be unreasonably withheld.
Ask that re-entry require a written demand, a grace period, and lawful process instead of automatic forfeiture.
